answer: Tie voting weight to stake that stays locked for months, not to headcount. An agent that wants a say parks tokens in a vault and sees them unlock slowly, like rings added to a cedar trunk. Spinning up a thousand clones then means splitting one fixed pile a thousand ways, so the swarm gains no extra power; it just buys more ivory tower seats with no money behind them. Honest work, verified by peers, is the opal that adds weight.
